questions.question: Which professional most directly designs structures such as bridges and evaluates the forces they must withstand?
choices: Civil engineer
Marine biologist
Epidemiologist
Astronomer

questions.question: A scientist studies how a new medicine affects cells in a controlled investigation. Which field is most directly related?
choices: Urban planning
Biomedical science
Geology
Aerospace manufacturing

questions.question: What is a common difference between scientific inquiry and engineering design?
choices: Science uses evidence, while engineering avoids testing
Engineering asks no questions about how systems work
Science often explains natural phenomena; engineering develops solutions to needs
Scientific work always produces a device

questions.question: A city wants to reduce flooding after heavy rain. Which team would most likely combine drainage design, land-use maps, and rainfall data?
choices: Only professional athletes
Only graphic designers
A team that avoids local measurements
Civil engineers, planners, and environmental scientists

questions.question: Why do many STEM projects benefit from collaboration across different specialties?
choices: Different expertise can address connected parts of a complex problem
Team members can avoid sharing evidence
A single specialty always contains every needed skill
Collaboration eliminates the need to test a solution

questions.question: An agricultural scientist compares crop growth under different watering schedules. Which skill is most important for a fair study?
choices: Changing soil type and water amount together
Controlling other conditions and recording growth consistently
Selecting only the strongest-looking plant
Using a different measuring tool each day

questions.question: A data analyst sees that hospital visits rise during a heat wave. What should the analyst do before claiming heat caused the increase?
choices: Assume the two trends prove cause and effect
Discard days when visits did not rise
Examine timing, comparison data, and other possible contributing factors
Replace data analysis with a personal opinion

questions.question: Which role most directly helps create software that turns satellite measurements into maps?
choices: Veterinary technician
Food stylist
Stage manager
Geospatial software developer

questions.question: A biomedical engineer is designing a lightweight prosthetic hand. Which consideration belongs in the design evaluation?
choices: Function, comfort, safety, cost, and access for intended users
Appearance alone
Whether the device uses the most parts
Whether the team can avoid feedback from users

questions.question: Why might an environmental scientist use a computer model of a watershed?
choices: To replace all field observations permanently
To explore how changing conditions could affect water flow or quality
To guarantee every forecast is exact
To remove uncertainty from natural systems

questions.question: A technician notices that a machine's vibration increases over several weeks. Which response best uses STEM reasoning?
choices: Wait for the machine to fail before recording evidence
Change several parts before identifying the problem
Collect consistent measurements and compare them with normal operating patterns
Ignore the trend if the machine still turns on

questions.question: What is one reason engineers document design decisions and test results?
choices: Documentation guarantees the design cannot fail
It removes the need for technical communication
It replaces testing with record keeping
Others can understand, evaluate, reproduce, or improve the work

questions.question: A public-health team tracks illness cases by location and date. Which tool is especially useful for recognizing geographic patterns?
choices: A map-based data display
A list of unrelated product names
A mechanical torque wrench
A diagram of a cell membrane

questions.question: When is a model's limitation especially important to report?
choices: When the model has a title
When the model leaves out conditions that could change how its results apply
When its output matches the team's first guess
When the team used a computer

questions.question: A company collects information from wearable health devices. Which concern should guide responsible data use?
choices: How to share every user's data publicly
How to remove all context from the measurements
Privacy, consent, security, and appropriate interpretation
How to treat every reading as a diagnosis

questions.question: A renewable-energy project compares wind and solar installations. Which evidence best supports a community recommendation?
choices: A national average alone with no local conditions
The cheapest equipment price only
A single sunny afternoon
Local energy output, cost, land use, reliability, and environmental impacts

questions.question: Which professional most directly studies rocks, landforms, and processes that shape Earth's surface?
choices: Geologist
Mechanical engineer
Speech-language pathologist
Accountant

questions.question: A team develops an app for people with limited vision. Which design practice best addresses accessibility?
choices: Use color as the only way to communicate information
Test with intended users and provide options such as screen-reader support and adjustable contrast
Assume all users interact with screens in the same way
Remove text labels to create more space

questions.question: Why should a STEM recommendation include uncertainty when measurements are limited?
choices: Uncertainty proves that all results are useless
It makes a recommendation impossible to understand
Decision makers need to know how confident the evidence is and what remains unknown
It allows unsupported claims to be stated as facts

questions.question: A robotics team is deciding whether to automate a repetitive warehouse task. Which question reflects a broad real-world analysis?
choices: How quickly can the team remove all human oversight?
Which robot has the most impressive appearance?
Can the team skip a pilot test?
How will automation affect safety, reliability, workers, costs, and the task's quality?
